newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN says 96/97 H1 pretax down 14.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: EVN says 96/97 H1 pretax down 14.1 pct.

text.p: Austrian regional utility company Energieversorgung Niederoesterreich AG (EVN) said on Tuesday pretax profit in the first half of the year fell 14.1 pct to 1.621 billion schillings ($133.1 million).

The company said in a statement it expected to pay out an unchanged dividend plus an anniversary bonus. In 1995/96 EVN paid out 23 schillings plus a bonus of two schillings. EVN's full year ends on August 31, 1997.
EVN's first half operating profit fell 17.4 percent to 1.43 billion schillings, while sales rose 1.2 percent to 7.029 billion schillings.
"The first half results cannot be simply doubled up to gain a full year 1996/97 result due to seasonal particularities in the energy industry," said EVN chief executive Rudolf Gruber.
Last year, EVN posted a 24.4 percent jump in pretax profit to 1.484 billion schillings.
